description: Async. Turn a URL, text, blog post, or existing PostKing post into new content for social media or blogs. IMPORTANT: When the source is a URL, pass it directly to this tool via sourceUrl — do NOT fetch or crawl the URL yourself first. PostKing handles all crawling internally. Source types: url | text | blog | social_post. Target types: social (LinkedIn, X, etc.) | blog | text. When targetType is 'blog', pass publicationId to choose which blog publication the generated article is filed under (ids from list_publications) — omit to fall back to the brand's default publication for the content's language. Returns { operationId, jobId, pollUrl, status } — poll get_job(operationId) until state is 'completed' (or 'failed'/'cancelled'); the generated posts/blog are in the completed job's result. Typically takes ~1–3 min.

angle.description: Specific angle or focus, e.g. 'focus on ROI data'

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

language.description: Output language for this generation, as a BCP-47 code. One of: en (English), es (Spanish), pt-BR (Portuguese (Brazil)), de (German), fr (French), cs (Czech). Omit to use the brand's configured content language (English if unset) — do NOT pass 'en' just to mean 'unspecified'. Does not translate anything already generated. The repurposed output is written in this language regardless of the source language.

publicationId.description: Which blog publication the generated article is filed under. Only used when targetType is 'blog' — ignored otherwise. Omit to use the brand's default publication for the content's language. Ids come from list_publications.

sourceBlogId.description: Existing PostKing blog article ID (when sourceType=blog). Get IDs from list_blogs.

sourceType.description: Where the source content comes from

textLength.description: For text target: short | medium | long | custom:<words>

voiceProfileIds.description: Voice profile IDs. Single ID applies to all platforms: ['clxvoice1']. Per-platform: ['x:clxvoice1','linkedin:clxvoice2']. Get IDs from list_voices.

name: repurpose_content
